# Solve separately for u and v
# u = uc + a*(xw-xt) + b*(yw-yt)
# design matrix [1, dx, dy]

def solve(obs, target_idx):
    # normal equations 3x3
    ATA=[[0.0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
    ATb=[0.0]*3
    for o in obs:
        xt,yt,u,v,xw,yw,name=o
        dx=xw-xt; dy=yw-yt
        y = u if target_idx==0 else v
        row=[1.0, dx, dy]
        for i in range(3):
            ATb[i]+=row[i]*y
            for j in range(3):
                ATA[i][j]+=row[i]*row[j]
    # gaussian elimination
    A=[ATA[i]+[ATb[i]] for i in range(3)]
    for col in range(3):
        # pivot
        piv=max(range(col,3), key=lambda i: abs(A[i][col]))
        A[col],A[piv]=A[piv],A[col]
        div=A[col][col]
        for j in range(col,4):
            A[col][j]/=div
        for i in range(3):
            if i==col: continue
            f=A[i][col]
            for j in range(col,4):
                A[i][j]-=f*A[col][j]
    return [A[i][3] for i in range(3)]

    dx=xw-xt; dy=yw-yt

    v=vc+c*dx+d*dy
